description: Metadata-only literature discovery settings for public intracellular EM dataset leads.

source_journal_groups.name: cell_biology_and_ultrastructure
source_journal_groups.description: High-value cell biology journals where source-data links for intracellular EM are common.

source_journal_groups.name: methods_and_broad_science
source_journal_groups.description: Methods and broad-scope journals that often publish volume EM datasets and public source data.

fib_sem: focused ion beam scanning electron microscopy

query_groups.name: volume_em_source_data
query_groups.query: ("volume electron microscopy" OR "FIB-SEM" OR "SBF-SEM" OR "serial block face") AND ("source data" OR dataset OR repository OR "data availability")
query_groups.crossref_query: volume electron microscopy FIB-SEM SBF-SEM serial block face source data dataset repository data availability

query_groups.name: tem_organelle_repository
query_groups.query: (TEM OR "transmission electron microscopy" OR ultrastructure) AND (organelle OR mitochondria OR "endoplasmic reticulum" OR nucleus) AND (dataset OR repository OR "source data")
query_groups.crossref_query: transmission electron microscopy TEM ultrastructure organelle mitochondria endoplasmic reticulum nucleus dataset repository source data

query_groups.name: em_repository_names
query_groups.query: ("electron microscopy" OR ultrastructure OR "volume EM") AND (EMPIAR OR BioStudies OR OpenOrganelle OR BossDB OR webKnossos OR Figshare OR Zenodo OR Dryad)
query_groups.crossref_query: electron microscopy ultrastructure volume EM EMPIAR BioStudies OpenOrganelle BossDB webKnossos Figshare Zenodo Dryad
